title: Caring Recharge Project for Caregivers of Individuals With Alzheimer's Disease
official: Recharge Behavioral Therapy for Caregivers of Individuals With Alzheimer's Disease
summary: This project will evaluate the effectiveness of the Recharge Behavioral Therapy (RBT) intervention to alleviate stress and depressive symptoms of caregivers of Individuals with Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementia.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Care for an individual with Alzheimer s Disease or other dementia.
* Have a Smartphone or tablet with Internet access.
* Minimum age of 18 years old.
* Spend at least 8 hours/week caring for a person with dementia.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe psychological or physical illness.
* Inability to read and follow instructions.
* Unwillingness to participate in all aspects of the study.
